codeProxy.input: raw integer RGB555 source command before HCS EOTF, GtG, aperture, and host conversion
codeProxy.classification: project reduction of three subpixel commands to the one scalar state available in RGBA32F alpha
codeProxy.limits: Equal-mean chromatic RGB555 triplets share one slow state; this is not a subpixel-resolved electrical model.

inputs.p: WS3 frame parity plus selected frame/row/column/dot spatial phase

invariants: deltaDC=0 produces u=0 exactly for every code, coordinate, polarity, and topology
SpatialRetention=0 produces u=deltaDC and exactly recovers the WS1 global-only path
displayed luma and optical feedback do not enter u
identical command/polarity histories produce identical state

state.equation: dx/dt=A*(u-x)-D*x for nonzero u; dx/dt=-D*x for zero u
state.storage: one signed float32 scalar per 240x160 source pixel in response-pass alpha

adsorptionRatePerSecond.classification: later laboratory-cell literature range, not AGS-101

desorptionRatePerSecond.classification: later laboratory-cell slow-component range, not AGS-101

state.secondState: not selected; Mizusaki two-component recovery is preserved as a future fit option requiring AGS waveform evidence

limitations: No AGS-101 VCOM, feed-through, gate waveform, capacitance, code-voltage curve, or residual-DC waveform selects the proxy weights.
The one scalar per source pixel is not subpixel-resolved and has no lateral ion diffusion or row-line gradient.
WS3 parity and inversion candidates remain unselected; generated results expose their sensitivity rather than choosing one.
The default represents a period-mechanism reconstruction, not measured or calibrated AGS-101 image sticking.
